tagline: Turn Zoom meeting outcomes into Todoist tasks automatically
metaTitle: Todoist + Zoom Integration: Zoom Action Items to Todoist
metaDescription: Pull action items from Zoom transcripts into Todoist and get a task briefing before calls. GAIA handles the follow-up. See the setup steps.
intro:
Zoom meetings generate commitments — someone agrees to send a document, another person will follow up with a client, a decision is made that requires someone to update the project plan. But without a reliable system for capturing these commitments the moment they're made, action items evaporate as quickly as the meeting window closes.

GAIA connects Zoom and Todoist so meeting outcomes flow directly into your task manager. When a meeting ends, GAIA can process the transcript to identify action items and create a task for each, assigned to the right person with a realistic due date. Before a meeting starts, GAIA checks your task list for items related to that meeting's attendees or project and surfaces them as a pre-meeting briefing so you walk in prepared.

This integration is essential for anyone who runs or participates in regular meetings and wants to close the gap between what gets committed in a call and what actually gets tracked and executed. It is particularly powerful for team leads, project managers, and client-facing professionals who have multiple meetings per day.

useCases.title: Auto-extract action items from Zoom transcripts
useCases.description: After a meeting, GAIA analyses the transcript for commitments and action items, creates tasks for each, and assigns them to the relevant team member with a suggested due date.

useCases.title: Pre-meeting task briefing
useCases.description: Fifteen minutes before a call, GAIA surfaces any open tasks related to the meeting's attendees or project so you can review outstanding items before the call starts.

useCases.title: Meeting summary to Todoist project
useCases.description: GAIA generates a structured meeting summary from the transcript and adds it as a comment to the relevant project, giving team members who missed the call a quick catch-up.

useCases.title: Recurring meeting task reset
useCases.description: For recurring meetings, GAIA recreates the standard preparation checklist before each occurrence so weekly syncs always start with the same level of preparation.

useCases.title: Follow-up deadline tracking
useCases.description: When action items are captured from a meeting, GAIA sets due dates based on what was said, 'by end of week' becomes Friday, 'tomorrow' becomes the next business day, and alerts you if they are not completed in time.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your account and connect Zoom via OAuth. Enable cloud recording and transcript generation so GAIA can process meeting content.
Configure which meetings should trigger task creation, which project receives the tasks, and whether action items should be auto-assigned or reviewed before saving.

howItWorks.step: GAIA processes meetings and creates tasks automatically
howItWorks.description: After each qualifying meeting, GAIA processes the transcript, extracts action items, and creates tasks, all within minutes of the meeting ending.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom cloud recording to extract action items?
faqs.answer: Cloud recording with auto-transcription is the most reliable method, but GAIA can also process meeting notes you paste manually if cloud transcripts are not available.

faqs.question: Can GAIA assign action items to other team members' Todoist accounts?
faqs.answer: If team members have also connected their accounts to GAIA, it can assign tasks to them directly. Otherwise, it assigns tasks to you with the responsible person noted in the task description.

faqs.question: How accurate is the action item extraction?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses language model analysis on the transcript to identify commitment patterns. You can configure a review step where extracted tasks are presented for approval before being saved.

faqs.question: Does this work with webinars as well as meetings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both meetings and webinars are supported, making it useful for post-webinar follow-up task creation as well as internal meeting action items.
